title: Add relationship-stage-aware prompt framing to chatbot/soul/relationship.py
description:
Implement relationship-stage-aware prompting in chatbot/soul/relationship.py. It must adapt the prompt framing based on the relationship depth, transitioning between stages such as acquaintance, established bond, and intimate.

Before editing, inspect:
- chatbot/soul/relationship.py to understand existing RelationshipConfig behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Prompt framing output changes dynamically based on relationship stage
All existing RelationshipConfig behaviors and properties remain intact
forbidden_changes: modify unrelated modules outside of chatbot/soul/
